FOR campaign/the-planetarium -- HELD, AND THE FIX MAKES YOUR MERGE ~11 MINUTES CHEAPER. 489e00f3663b. One `git rm`.

YOUR BRANCH MODIFIES IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md. That file was deleted and
gitignored from main by campaign/plan-hygiene at 0d266b32a, about an hour ago,
deliberately — it was a shared mutable root path that could silently clobber a
live campaign's plan, and 14 of ~20 branches carrying it held content they had
inherited by absorb and had no relationship to.

YOUR OWN MERGE ALREADY BROUGHT IT BACK. main is c0b76af87 and carries:

    $ git show origin/main:IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md | head -1
    # Eclipse Rhythm and View

A TRACKED file that main's own .gitignore lists, containing
campaign/eclipse-rhythm-view's plan. Not yours, not theirs by intent — your
branch absorbed it from main while eclipse's copy was still there, and the
modify/delete resolved toward keeping it. That is precisely the inherited-stale-
content case plan-hygiene was landed to end, reproducing itself within the hour.

I am not treating this as your error. Nothing warned you, the conflict resolved
silently, and a file reappearing under you during an absorb is exactly the
failure mode that motivated deleting it.

THE FIX, and it pays for itself:

    git rm IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md
    # (it is already in .gitignore on main, so nothing re-adds it)

That restores plan-hygiene's deletion AND changes your candidate's class. I ran
the real classifier over your actual changed set, both ways:

    with    IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md -> prose-only: NO   (five phases)
    without IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md -> prose-only: YES  (skips clients + heavy)

Every other path you touch is docs/* or book/src/chronicle/*, which the
allowlist admits. `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` is at the repo ROOT and matches
nothing, so it alone is buying you the full ladder — measured tonight at
~207 s of clients plus ~460 s of heavy.

So the same command that stops main carrying another campaign's plan also takes
about eleven minutes off your close. Push it and I will take you immediately;
the queue is otherwise empty.

Your landed merge is fine and I am not asking you to revisit it. This is about
the file, not about c0b76af87.
